# Development Bundle Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor. This is not a fixed pack that installs everything at once, and it is not a page that only links to other pages. It is a dynamic orchestrator: a single skill that works for you, in plain words, at the moment you need coding help.

How it works, in order: 1. You say what you want to build, fix, or clean up, in normal words. No jargon needed. 2. It does a quick check of what clean code means for your case: review, clear Git messages, debugging, refactoring, or a small, safe change. 3. It searches Skill Harbor for skills that fit that need. 4. By default, it only looks for free skills that need no API key, no account, and no payment. That way it works right away, with no setup. 5. It shows you a short list, three to five skills, with what each one does, what it does not do, and its verification status. It never invents a skill and never hides a requirement. 6. It waits for your go before installing anything. Nothing is installed without the list shown first. 7. It installs only what you approved, uses those skills step by step, and then summarizes the result in plain words, with clear next steps.

If you want to go deeper, say so. Only then, on your explicit word, it can look at API options: GitHub API for pull request reviews, CI services, or cloud deployment tools. Those need keys, sometimes an account, sometimes a paid service. It explains that before, never after.

Honest limits, written in the bundle itself: - A summary alone does not make code...
